hints.text: The Margins are the pages beside the garden. Come through the gate any time.
Prints like to follow a trail. Walk on, and see where yours goes.
Glyph crumbs lie in the grass under the trees. Prints are fond of them.
Night changes what you can find. Come back when the lanterns are lit.
Folded pages hide in the Margins. Hold E beside one to unfold it.
Home has little plots for small things. Go through the door and see.
The map lives under the M key. It remembers where you have walked.
Ink puddles gather by the inkwell. Your pouch only holds a few.
